science_question: How does simultaneously valid detector calibration granularity affect robustness of the original 96 civil-bin clock, solar phase and seasonal fixed-trained prediction score rankings, especially when detector sensitivity varies inside presumed 4h camera-q blocks?

temporal_patterns.expression: each six block probability repeated over sixteen 15-min bins
base_six_block_q + 0.13*sin(2*pi*(index_mod16 + 0.5)/16), exactly zero mean for each block

biological_q_truth.reference_truth: Independent separately verified known passage opportunity triggers per original date × selected clock interval; sensor detection outcome Binomial with q in that actual reference interval. For broad 4h bins, trials independently draw clock sub-bin uniformly within the interval, so total focal-camera success is legitimately Binomial(n, mean of sixteen sub-bin q), even when within-block q is heterogeneous; the MEAN interval does NOT cover 15-minute q when heterogeneous.

calibration_experiment.confidence_method: Clopper-Pearson exact two-sided per original-date detector group with Bonferroni across ALL dates and all groups in that method, using beta inverse quantile at alpha/(2 * number_of_groups).
calibration_experiment.equal_opportunity_cost: 82*6*n_6block = 82*96*n_96bin EXACTLY per budget; source reference observations are independent of synthetic animal detections.
calibration_experiment.independent_reference_rng: numpy SeedSequence([2026101017, pattern_index, budget_index, method_index, 999]) generates all binomial reference samples for 82 days; same calibration source for all 3 animal truths and 2 event abundance levels, independent of wildlife.
calibration_experiment.confidence_source_q_bounds: Four-hour CP q intervals guarantee the four-hour reference-AVERAGED detector q only; they do NOT guarantee every of the original 15min q unless constancy within 4hour block is separately true.
calibration_experiment.animal_model_training: Reuse existing five predeclared PR245 families and original training physical site split; fit on the actually detected synthetic clock counts with unknown q then KEEP fitted candidate peaks fixed across both calibration methods and q bounds. No refitting under q uncertainty.

score_bounds.mechanism: For each day, given two already trained common civil-bin probability vectors a,b and the SAME detector q across both models, score difference includes log(a_k/b_k) minus log((a·q)/(b·q)). Use sharp 65-step fractional-linear roots on common q box. Group each sixteen original quarter-hour bins for six-block q and use all original 96 bins for fine q. Day-by-day q uncertainty and same q across 16 heldout sites per day.
score_bounds.confidence_interpretation: The joint CP calibration box covers TRUE q for ALL day×clock bins with probability >=.975 only when the calibration q granularity is correct. On that event, the FIXED observed animal count's TRUE-q comparative sample score is contained in the computed score envelope. This is a conditional CALIBRATION uncertainty statement, not a confidence interval on expected score for new sites and not an animal-behavior significance test.
score_bounds.validity_indicator: Check realized calibration simultaneous coverage of actual 15min q values. For 6block method in heterogeneous world, the sampling model correctly calibrates each 4h *average*, but it is INVALID for 15-minute q and its reported intervals are descriptive only.

outputs_and_stops: 3 animal truths ×2 event counts ×2 actual q patterns ×2 equal total source budgets ×2 calibration methods ×4 fixed pairwise model comparisons =192 full reports.
all 82 original calendar dates and 96 civil time bins retained
all calibration group CP intervals positive; if lower zero in any group, explicitly HOLD and do not optimize ratio over nonpositive q
same total independent reference opportunities for both methods at each budget; no real hardware or economic cost equivalence claimed
delta0 if known exact true q should recover a fixed score; reported envelope contains true-q fixed-count heldout score ONLY for valid calibration coverage and correctly specified q temporal structure
for genuinely block-constant q, both 6block and 96bin calibration q bands are mathematically valid for actual model q; report joint coverage and robust score-rank decisions

for actual heterogeneous q within a 4h block, 6block binomial confidence can be CORRECT FOR the 4h averaged q and STILL INVALID for 15-minute q. Treat any 6block ranking as UNSAFE unless independent within-block invariance evidence exists.
Do not turn model score confidence boxes into confidence intervals on source animal rate, out-of-sample expected score, unknown true photoperiod sensitivity or a biological zeitgeber
same fixed original candidate model shape and heldout physical-site sample with no outcome-based cherry picking of windows
all prior #245/#256 and qualified ODSP training-process/external-validation results unchanged
no original source camera uptime, ungulate detections, site GPS, or independent reference true passages read
